author: Claude Agent Marketplace
capabilities: Statistical analysis with rigorous hypothesis testing (p<0.05)
Machine learning model development and validation
Exploratory data analysis and pattern discovery
Time series forecasting and trend analysis

parameters.dataset_path: Path to dataset (CSV, Parquet, Excel, etc.)

parameters.model_type: Model type: regression, classification, timeseries, clustering, auto

parameters.analysis_path: Path to completed analysis or model results

use_cases: Sales forecasting with time series models
A/B test design and statistical analysis
Causal impact analysis for business decisions
best_practices: Test model assumptions before applying methods
Report effect sizes along with p-values
Document all preprocessing and feature engineering steps
Check for bias and fairness systematically
Ensure reproducibility with version control and seeds
Quantify business impact in dollars or KPIs
Be transparent about limitations and uncertainty
Start simple, add complexity as justified
Validate on holdout data before deployment
Tailor communication to audience (technical vs business)
Follow up on implementation and measure actual impact
